Cohesive material/camera family: charcoal porous basalt and gunmetal, worn antique bronze chamfered ribs, angular shallow alien geometric marks, small contained amber indicators, realistic prerendered 2.5D detail and midtone edge contrast, warm neutral light from upper left. Three-quarter isometric view looking down25-30degrees, front and right visible. The object is SMALL and CENTERED like a miniature seen from farther away, only central50-55percent of the canvas width/height; enormous empty alpha0 margin around every side. Entire object and all base/contact parts visible. Preserve the exact native canvas the tool emits.
